verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs claim a performant, compiler-optimized reactive rendering system that rarely needs manual optimization. They also describe an ecosystem that scales from library to full framework, with official Router, Pinia and tooling, and one team reports being happier after migrating with official router/store building blocks. However, the first-party evidence is tagline-level, and several community members describe Vue as less suited to complex apps, citing 'magical' behavior, implicit state changes, Vuex modularity issues and weak TypeScript typing. These are opinion-level concerns rather than concrete documented failures, so they lower quality rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on large-app architecture and maintainability at scale, performance evidence for large codebases, independent corroboration of team-scale maintainability, strong TypeScript support evidence.
